appearances.title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
appearances.headline: OpenAI launches Patch the Planet vulnerability coordination effort
appearances.newly_possible: Open source maintainers can be connected with researchers and incident responders when agents uncover critical vulnerabilities in their code.
appearances.why: If agents find bugs faster than maintainers can fix them, coordinated disclosure becomes a bottleneck worth planning for.
appearances.limits: It is a coordination program, not a released tool, and results are not shown.
